patterns: No PYQs filed here; APPSC typically handles caste through reformers (Phule, Ambedkar, Periyar, Narayana Guru, Jashuva) and constitutional articles (Art. 15, 17) rather than the abstract term 'casteism'.
Expect direct one-liners: book-author (Gulamgiri, Annihilation of Caste, Gabbilam), organisation-year (Satyashodhak 1873, Self-Respect 1925), Article 17 = untouchability.
AP tilt: Justice Party and Communal G.O. 1921, Karamchedu and Dalit Mahasabha, Raghupati Venkataratnam Naidu.
App leans on 2025-26 current items (UGC 2026 regulations, census caste enumeration) and definitional quotes; these are beyond typical APPSC depth but acceptable.
